decisionsTitle: The «Vii?» card and «Cine vine» are closed folds, and the «Da, vin» link counts you when it opens (amending §812 and §143)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-19**, of the event page's «Vii?» card: «Asta ar trebui să fie collapsed, ca și condițiile de participare»; of the link page «Confirmă că vii»: «Asta ar trebui să se auto-bifeze când deschid»; of the public list: «Și aici trebuie să fie la fel: „Cine vine” collapsed».

**Decision.** No new rule, three amendments. **The «Vii?» card (§812) is a closed fold**, the same `<details>` as «Condiții de participare» (§498): the 44-pixel bar, a glyph and a real `h2` in the summary, the id `vin` on the fold itself so a link to `#vin` — the calendar's «Vin! →», the listing's chip, the landing after «Da, vin» — opens it through `OpenFoldFromHash`, and the answer a post leaves in the address (`?vin=…`) opens it on the server so its sentence is read. Its line carries what a reader decides by, in the house's count form: «Vii? · 3 vin», «Vii? · Fii primul care spune că vine.» when nobody has answered, «Vii? · Tu vii ✓ · 3 vin» once the one island (`RsvpRemembered`) knows this browser answered, and nothing about the count while the database is away (§281); inside, the form or the one-tap state, its help, «Nu mai vin» and then «Vin (N)» with the names that may be shown (§143). **«Cine vine» (§143, §250, §396, §628) was already a closed native disclosure** (on a group run, where no list is published, the list of names the owner saw open was «Vin (N)», which now sits inside the closed «Vii?» fold) with its count in the title; it now has the same bar as the other two — a real `h2` in the `<summary>`, «Cine vine (N)» on its line (just «Cine vine» when the count is not public), the table, the legend and the notes inside — and keeps its anchor `#start-list-title`, which the pager's links and `OpenFoldFromHash` open. The results section «Clasament» (§809) stays as it is: after a race the results are the point of the page. **The link page of a «Da, vin» message (§811) presses its own button** when a person opens it in a browser: the GET still renders the sentence, the POST form and the button and writes nothing (AGENTS.md §12.8, BR-REQ-036-02 criterion 4), and one small client island (`AutoConfirm`) calls the form's `requestSubmit()` once — not while the browser prerenders the page or its tab is in the background — so the pending label «Te numărăm…» shows and the unchanged POST spends the link, remembers the browser and lands on the event page's open «Vii?» fold. Without JavaScript, and for a scanner that fetches the link without running its scripts, the button stays and counts nobody; the «Nu mai vin» link, a spent, expired or already-counted link keep their press. **Accepted residual risk:** a link sandbox that renders the page in a real browser, with scripts, looks like a shown tab and presses; the person's own click then reads «Ești deja numărat» and their browser is not remembered. The owner accepted it for «auto-bifeze când deschid»; «Nu mai vin» in the same email takes the answer back, and a later rule (for example skipping the press when `navigator.webdriver` is true) is the owner's call.

**Refused.** An auto-submit from the GET itself, or a link that counts on being fetched (a scanner would count everybody); a fold per part of the card (the form, the count) instead of one; the count only inside the fold (a reader decides by it before opening); folding «Clasament».

**Tests.** The e2e specs that read a name, a state, the form or the count on the event page open the fold first through one helper, `openEventFold(page, "rsvp-box" | "start-list" | "conditions-fold")` in `tests/e2e/support/fold.ts`: `tests/e2e/hidden-list.spec.ts`, `tests/e2e/public-list-club.spec.ts`, `tests/e2e/public-list-states.spec.ts` (which also asserts «Cine vine» arrives closed) and `tests/e2e/rsvp.spec.ts` (the closed «Vii?» fold, the link page counting by itself, and a scripts-off context for the no-JavaScript button). The three public folds share one `PUBLIC_FOLD_SX` in `src/shared/ui/disclosure.ts`.
changelogLine: - **«Vii?» and «Cine vine» are closed folds, and the «Da, vin» link counts you when it opens** — the card has «Vii? · N vin» (or «Tu vii ✓») on its line, `#vin` and an answer's redirect open it; the list has the same bar with «Cine vine (N)»; the link page presses its own button once in a browser, and keeps the button for a scanner and for no JavaScript. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event page that offers «Vii?» or publishes the participants' list, when it renders, then «Vii?» and «Cine vine» are each one native `<details>` closed on arrival, with a real `h2` in the summary and the count on the line («Vii? · 3 vin», «Vii? · Fii primul care spune că vine.», «Cine vine (3)»), the id `vin` on the card's fold so a link to `#vin` opens it, and the card open on the server when the address carries an answer (`?vin=`); the results section stays as it was (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the page of a live, uncounted «Da, vin» link, when it is requested, then it renders the sentence, the POST form and the button inside one island that presses that button once only while the page is not prerendered and its tab is shown, and the request itself writes nothing; a scanner that fetches without running scripts and a browser without JavaScript see the button and count nobody; the «Nu mai vin» page, a spent, expired or already-counted link draw no island (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the «Vii?» card and «Cine vine» are closed folds with the count on their line; opening the «Da, vin» link counts you without a press
